prompt:
Use case: identity-preserve. Asset type: ONE individual full-body transparent 2D fighting-game action sprite of ABSTRACTING JAX. Reference 1 is the approved strict design lock for silhouette, proportions, exact transformation patches, eyes, colours and polished cel shading. Reference 2 supplies official design details only; do not imitate its squat toy proportions, setting or lighting. Tall lanky purple cartoon rabbit, two very long ears, long thin limbs, pink overalls/yellow buttons. One normal yellow eye with black rectangular pupil, one yellow glove and broad purple foot. Opposing head half, very long ear, arm and leg are angular dark crystal with concentric pastel eyes. Keep exactly the approved anatomical side of every transformation and all normal body sections; not fully abstracted or chibi. Create a genuinely distinct natural action pose, not a mirrored/cropped selection image. Every limb, crown/hat/ear tip, attached mask and crystal spike must fit fully inside clear transparent margins on ALL sides. One connected character, crisp detailed 2D art on true transparent RGBA; no scenery, floor, cast shadow, aura, glow, particles, labels, watermark, inset or duplicate. POSE: WALK toward screen RIGHT: natural long stride with one foot forward and opposing arm swing, rear heel lifting, torso balanced. Distinct walking pose, not neutral standing.
WALK ARM-SWING CORRECTION: the anatomical LEFT CRYSTAL LEG is the leading leg stepping forward toward screen RIGHT; its LEFT CRYSTAL ARM must swing BACK behind the torso toward screen LEFT. The anatomical RIGHT normal purple leg trails behind toward screen LEFT, while the RIGHT PURPLE ARM with the YELLOW GLOVE swings FORWARD toward screen RIGHT. Use this natural opposite-arm/opposite-leg walking pattern. Do not move the crystal transformation to different limbs; only change arm pose.

portableReferences.restoreInstruction: The exact reference is archived in this repository. If unavailable, download the named official image URL, verify and visually inspect it before generation. For an expired storyboard URL, refresh the storyboard through the official episode player metadata.

observations: Corrected long walk toward screen right with natural opposing arm swing: crystal anatomical-left leg steps forward while its crystal arm swings back; normal right leg trails while the yellow-gloved right hand swings forward. Tall ears, partial crystal face, overalls, two hands and both feet remain complete. Distinct stride without a floor or motion effect.
Native RGBA and clear threshold-12 contour margins verified; source bytes unchanged.
